audit_status.source_base: Greek Philippians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for unity/humility, Messiah hymn, working out salvation, shining as lights, Timothy/Epaphroditus.

verses.restored: Therefore if there is any encouragement in Messiah, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship/participation of Spirit, if any inward affections and compassions,

familiar.text: If there be therefore any consolation in Christ, if any comfort of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any bowels and mercies,

modern.text: Therefore if you have any encouragement in Christ, if any comfort from His love, if any fellowship with the Spirit, if any affection and compassion,

original.text: Εἴ τις οὖν παράκλησις ἐν Χριστῷ, εἴ τι παραμύθιον ἀγάπης, εἴ τις κοινωνία πνεύματος, εἴ τις σπλάγχνα καὶ οἰκτιρμοί,

verses.restored: complete my joy: that you think the same, having the same love, joined in soul/life, thinking the one thing,

familiar.text: Fulfil ye my joy, that ye be likeminded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind.

modern.text: then make my joy complete by being like-minded, having the same love, being united in spirit and purpose.

original.text: πληρώσατέ μου τὴν χαρὰν ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ φρονῆτε, τὴν αὐτὴν ἀγάπην ἔχοντες, σύμψυχοι, τὸ ἓν φρονοῦντες,

verses.restored: nothing according to selfish ambition or empty glory, but in humility counting one another as surpassing yourselves,

familiar.text: Let nothing be done through strife or vainglory; but in lowliness of mind let each esteem other better than themselves.

modern.text: Do nothing out of selfish ambition or empty pride, but in humility consider others more important than yourselves.

original.text: μηδὲν κατʼ ἐριθείαν ⸂μηδὲ κατὰ⸃ κενοδοξίαν, ἀλλὰ τῇ ταπεινοφροσύνῃ ἀλλήλους ἡγούμενοι ὑπερέχοντας ἑαυτῶν,

verses.restored: not looking each to one's own things, but each also to the things of others.

familiar.text: Look not every man on his own things, but every man also on the things of others.

modern.text: Each of you should look not only to your own interests, but also to the interests of others. The Mind of Christ (Isaiah 52:13–15)

original.text: μὴ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ⸀ἕκαστοι ⸀σκοποῦντες, ἀλλὰ καὶ τὰ ἑτέρων ⸁ἕκαστοι.

verses.restored: Let this mind be in you which also was in Messiah Jesus,

familiar.text: Let this mind be in you, which was also in Christ Jesus:

modern.text: Let this mind be in you which was also in Christ Jesus:

original.text: τοῦτο ⸀φρονεῖτε ἐν ὑμῖν ὃ καὶ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ,

verses.restored: who, existing in form of the Divine, did not regard equality with the Divine as something to be seized/exploited,

familiar.text: Who, being in the form of God, thought it not robbery to be equal with God:

modern.text: Who, existing in the form of God, did not consider equality with God something to be grasped,

original.text: ὃς ἐν μορφῇ θεοῦ ὑπάρχων οὐχ ἁρπαγμὸν ἡγήσατο τὸ εἶναι ἴσα θεῷ,

verses.restored: but emptied himself, taking form of servant, coming to be in likeness of humans; and being found in shape as human,

familiar.text: But made himself of no reputation, and took upon him the form of a servant, and was made in the likeness of men:

modern.text: but emptied Himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in human likeness.

original.text: ἀλλὰ ἑαυτὸν ἐκένωσεν μορφὴν δούλου λαβών, ἐν ὁμοιώματι ἀνθρώπων γενόμενος· καὶ σχήματι εὑρεθεὶς ὡς ἄνθρωπος

verses.restored: he humbled himself, becoming obedient until death, even death of a cross.

familiar.text: And being found in fashion as a man, he humbled himself, and became obedient unto death, even the death of the cross.

modern.text: And being found in appearance as a man, He humbled Himself and became obedient to death— even death on a cross.

original.text: ἐταπείνωσεν ἑαυτὸν γενόμενος ὑπήκοος μέχρι θανάτου, θανάτου δὲ σταυροῦ·

verses.restored: Therefore also the Divine highly exalted him and graced him with the name above every name,

familiar.text: Wherefore God also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name:

modern.text: Therefore God exalted Him to the highest place and gave Him the name above all names,

original.text: διὸ καὶ ὁ θεὸς αὐτὸν ὑπερύψωσεν, καὶ ἐχαρίσατο αὐτῷ ⸀τὸ ὄνομα τὸ ὑπὲρ πᾶν ὄνομα,

verses.restored: so that at the name of Jesus every knee should bend, of heavenly and earthly and under-earthly ones,

familiar.text: That at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of things in heaven, and things in earth, and things under the earth;

modern.text: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, in heaven and on earth and under the earth,

original.text: ἵνα ἐν τῷ ὀνόματι Ἰησοῦ πᾶν γόνυ κάμψῃ ἐπουρανίων καὶ ἐπιγείων καὶ καταχθονίων,

verses.restored: and every tongue should confess that Jesus Messiah is Lord, into glory of Divine Father.

familiar.text: And that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

modern.text: and every tongue confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father. Lights in the World (Matthew 5:13–16)

original.text: καὶ πᾶσα γλῶσσα ἐξομολογήσηται ὅτι κύριος Ἰησοῦς Χριστὸς εἰς δόξαν θεοῦ πατρός.

verses.restored: So then, my beloved, just as you always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation/healing with fear/reverence and trembling,

familiar.text: Wherefore, my beloved, as ye have always obeyed, not as in my presence only, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

modern.text: Therefore, my beloved, just as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now even more in my absence, continue to work out your salvation with fear and trembling.

original.text: Ὥστε, ἀγαπητοί μου, καθὼς πάντοτε ὑπηκούσατε, μὴ ὡς ἐν τῇ παρουσίᾳ μου μόνον ἀλλὰ νῦν πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἐν τῇ ἀπουσίᾳ μου, μετὰ φόβου καὶ τρόμου τὴν ἑαυτῶν σωτηρίαν κατεργάζεσθε,

verses.restored: for the Divine is the One working in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

familiar.text: For it is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure.

modern.text: For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.

original.text: ⸀θεὸς γάρ ἐστιν ὁ ἐνεργῶν ἐν ὑμῖν καὶ τὸ θέλειν καὶ τὸ ἐνεργεῖν ὑπὲρ τῆς εὐδοκίας.

verses.restored: Do all things without grumblings and arguments,

familiar.text: Do all things without murmurings and disputings:

modern.text: Do everything without complaining or arguing,

original.text: Πάντα ποιεῖτε χωρὶς γογγυσμῶν καὶ διαλογισμῶν,

verses.restored: so that you may become blameless and innocent, children of the Divine without blemish in the midst of a crooked and distorted generation, among whom you shine as lights in the world,

familiar.text: That ye may be blameless and harmless, the sons of God, without rebuke, in the midst of a crooked and perverse nation, among whom ye shine as lights in the world;

modern.text: so that you may be blameless and pure, children of God without fault in a crooked and perverse generation, in which you shine as lights in the world

original.text: ἵνα γένησθε ἄμεμπτοι καὶ ἀκέραιοι, τέκνα θεοῦ ⸂ἄμωμα μέσον⸃ γενεᾶς σκολιᾶς καὶ διεστραμμένης, ἐν οἷς φαίνεσθε ὡς φωστῆρες ἐν κόσμῳ

verses.restored: holding fast the word of life, into my boast for the day of Messiah, that I did not run in vain nor labor in vain.

familiar.text: Holding forth the word of life; that I may rejoice in the day of Christ, that I have not run in vain, neither laboured in vain.

modern.text: as you hold forth the word of life, in order that I may boast on the day of Christ that I did not run or labor in vain.

original.text: λόγον ζωῆς ἐπέχοντες, εἰς καύχημα ἐμοὶ εἰς ἡμέραν Χριστοῦ, ὅτι οὐκ εἰς κενὸν ἔδραμον οὐδὲ εἰς κενὸν ἐκοπίασα.

verses.restored: But even if I am being poured out as drink offering upon the sacrifice and service of your trust, I rejoice and rejoice together with all of you.

familiar.text: Yea, and if I be offered upon the sacrifice and service of your faith, I joy, and rejoice with you all.

modern.text: But even if I am being poured out like a drink offering on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with all of you.

original.text: ἀλλὰ εἰ καὶ σπένδομαι ἐπὶ τῇ θυσίᾳ καὶ λειτουργίᾳ τῆς πίστεως ὑμῶν, χαίρω καὶ συγχαίρω πᾶσιν ὑμῖν·

verses.restored: And in the same way you also rejoice and rejoice together with me.

familiar.text: For the same cause also do ye joy, and rejoice with me.

modern.text: So you too should be glad and rejoice with me. Timothy and Epaphroditus (1 Corinthians 16:10–12)

original.text: τὸ δὲ αὐτὸ καὶ ὑμεῖς χαίρετε καὶ συγχαίρετέ μοι.

verses.restored: But I hope in Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, so that I also may be of good soul/life, knowing the things concerning you.

familiar.text: But I trust in the Lord Jesus to send Timotheus shortly unto you, that I also may be of good comfort, when I know your state.

modern.text: Now I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered when I learn how you are doing.

original.text: Ἐλπίζω δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ Ἰησοῦ Τιμόθεον ταχέως πέμψαι ὑμῖν, ἵνα κἀγὼ εὐψυχῶ γνοὺς τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν.

verses.restored: For I have no one equal-souled who will genuinely care for the things concerning you.

familiar.text: For I have no man likeminded, who will naturally care for your state.

modern.text: I have nobody else like him who will genuinely care for your needs.

original.text: οὐδένα γὰρ ἔχω ἰσόψυχον ὅστις γνησίως τὰ περὶ ὑμῶν μεριμνήσει,

verses.restored: For all seek their own things, not the things of Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: For all seek their own, not the things which are Jesus Christ’s.

modern.text: For all the others look after their own interests, not those of Jesus Christ.

original.text: οἱ πάντες γὰρ τὰ ἑαυτῶν ζητοῦσιν, οὐ τὰ ⸂Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ⸃.

verses.restored: But you know his tested character, that as child with father he served with me in the good news.

familiar.text: But ye know the proof of him, that, as a son with the father, he hath served with me in the gospel.

modern.text: But you know Timothy’s proven worth, that as a child with his father he has served with me to advance the gospel.

original.text: τὴν δὲ δοκιμὴν αὐτοῦ γινώσκετε, ὅτι ὡς πατρὶ τέκνον σὺν ἐμοὶ ἐδούλευσεν εἰς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον.

verses.restored: Therefore I hope to send this one immediately, whenever I see the things concerning me.

familiar.text: Him therefore I hope to send presently, so soon as I shall see how it will go with me.

modern.text: So I hope to send him as soon as I see what happens with me.

original.text: τοῦτον μὲν οὖν ἐλπίζω πέμψαι ὡς ἂν ἀφίδω τὰ περὶ ἐμὲ ἐξαυτῆς·

verses.restored: And I have been persuaded in the Lord that I myself also will come soon.

familiar.text: But I trust in the Lord that I also myself shall come shortly.

modern.text: And I trust in the Lord that I myself will come soon.

original.text: πέποιθα δὲ ἐν κυρίῳ ὅτι καὶ αὐτὸς ταχέως ἐλεύσομαι.

verses.restored: But I considered it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my sibling and coworker and fellow soldier, your apostle/messenger and servant of my need,

familiar.text: Yet I supposed it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, and companion in labour, and fellowsoldier, but your messenger, and he that ministered to my wants.

modern.text: But I thought it necessary to send back to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, and fellow soldier, who is also your messenger and minister to my needs.

original.text: Ἀναγκαῖον δὲ ἡγησάμην Ἐπαφρόδιτον τὸν ἀδελφὸν καὶ συνεργὸν καὶ συστρατιώτην μου, ὑμῶν δὲ ἀπόστολον καὶ λειτουργὸν τῆς χρείας μου, πέμψαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς,

verses.restored: since he was longing for all of you and distressed because you heard that he was sick.

familiar.text: For he longed after you all, and was full of heaviness, because that ye had heard that he had been sick.

modern.text: For he has been longing for all of you and is distressed because you heard he was ill.

original.text: ἐπειδὴ ἐπιποθῶν ἦν πάντας ⸀ὑμᾶς, καὶ ἀδημονῶν διότι ἠκούσατε ὅτι ἠσθένησεν.

verses.restored: For indeed he was sick, near death; but the Divine showed mercy to him, and not to him only but also to me, lest I should have grief upon grief.

familiar.text: For indeed he was sick nigh unto death: but God had mercy on him; and not on him only, but on me also, lest I should have sorrow upon sorrow.

modern.text: He was sick indeed, nearly unto death. But God had mercy on him, and not only on him but also on me, to spare me sorrow upon sorrow.

original.text: καὶ γὰρ ἠσθένησεν παραπλήσιον ⸀θανάτῳ· ἀλλὰ ὁ θεὸς ⸂ἠλέησεν αὐτόν⸃, οὐκ αὐτὸν δὲ μόνον ἀλλὰ καὶ ἐμέ, ἵνα μὴ λύπην ἐπὶ λύπην σχῶ.

verses.restored: Therefore I sent him more eagerly, so that seeing him again you may rejoice and I may be less grieved.

familiar.text: I sent him therefore the more carefully, that, when ye see him again, ye may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

modern.text: Therefore I am all the more eager to send him, so that when you see him again you may rejoice, and I may be less anxious.

original.text: σπουδαιοτέρως οὖν ἔπεμψα αὐτὸν ἵνα ἰδόντες αὐτὸν πάλιν χαρῆτε κἀγὼ ἀλυπότερος ὦ.

verses.restored: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such ones in honor,

familiar.text: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all gladness; and hold such in reputation:

modern.text: Welcome him in the Lord with great joy, and honor men like him,

original.text: προσδέχεσθε οὖν αὐτὸν ἐν κυρίῳ μετὰ πάσης χαρᾶς, καὶ τοὺς τοιούτους ἐντίμους ἔχετε,

verses.restored: because through the work of Messiah he came near to death, risking his soul/life, so that he might fill up what was lacking in your service toward me.

familiar.text: Because for the work of Christ he was nigh unto death, not regarding his life, to supply your lack of service toward me.

modern.text: because he nearly died for the work of Christ, risking his life to make up for your deficit of service to me.

original.text: ὅτι διὰ τὸ ἔργον ⸀Χριστοῦ μέχρι θανάτου ἤγγισεν, ⸀παραβολευσάμενος τῇ ψυχῇ ἵνα ἀναπληρώσῃ τὸ ὑμῶν ὑστέρημα τῆς πρός με λειτουργίας.

translation_notes: The Messiah hymn centers non-exploitative Divine form: equality with Divine is not seized but expressed through self-emptying service.
Work out salvation/healing is held together with Divine working within; this is participation, not self-salvation.
